process.title: Requirements
process.body: You send screens or a Figma link, target iOS version and API docs. Delivery clock starts here.

process.title: Foundation
process.body: Design tokens, navigation shell and data models land. You get a build to run.

process.title: Screens
process.body: Feature screens built against real or mock data. Daily push to your repo.

process.title: Ship
process.body: Code walkthrough, revision round, and a checklist for App Store submission.

fit_title: Is this the right project for you?
fit_good: You have designs, a Figma file, or a clear reference app
You want native SwiftUI, not React Native or Flutter
You need finance-grade care: security, accuracy, edge cases
You want code your own team can read and extend
fit_bad: You need a backend or API built from scratch
You want an Android app in the same order
The scope is open-ended or still being decided
You need it live in under a week
